_comment: Each entry is built from extension/<source> into dist/<id>.dg and deployed to <target> by scripts/deploy.mjs. Per-org ids (bot, the 24 hourly sweeps jitsweepa..x, the widget) live in extension/org.json, written by scripts/install.mjs. Scheduler names must be letters only or creation fails with a bare operation_failed.

functions.name: jitaction
functions.description: JIT Access Bot buttons that open forms (request, change, reject, ask, answer, extend, manual review), cancel a request, or connect an approver.

functions.name: jitform
functions.description: JIT Access Bot forms: access request, ask for details, answer, reject.

functions.name: jitgrant
functions.description: JIT Access Bot Approve, Retry and Close buttons: decide, then add the requester and confirm it.

functions.name: jitchange
functions.description: JIT Access Bot Change & approve form: approve with a new end time, then add the requester.

functions.name: jitend
functions.description: JIT Access Bot buttons on live access: End access now, Retry removal, Mark resolved, Approve or Reject an extension.

functions.name: jitactive
functions.description: JIT Access Bot forms about live access: request more time, mark a failed removal for manual review.

functions.name: jitconfirm
functions.description: JIT Access widget confirmations: end access, cancel, retry removal, resolve, extension decisions.

functions.name: jitwidget
functions.description: JIT Access widget buttons: open the confirmation form for the chosen action.
